sourceObservations.observation: Public Shadcn MessageScroller/Button adapted through React; named reading composition disables duplicate generic anchor compensation. Bridge ref is published after Adapter setup.

No pixel threshold determines follow state. App reads following and invokes pauseFollowing/jumpToEnd. Active/epoch/viewport guard queued work; unmount unsubscribes and disconnects; focused jump control remains mounted.

Persisted App key survives materialization. Shared following transitions govern pause/resume; old frames, timers, observers and callbacks retire with active epoch. onContentFocus pauses for reader navigation.
Reading owners are keyed by surface/source/subject; disposed renderer rejects late patch and unmounts once.

Original 2px tolerance and 96 Shift+Tab budget preserved; four runs exercise production assets. Driver input, scripted selection, explicit resume focus and deliberately replayed observers remain identified separately.

limitations: No new browser/native execution in this projection
